welcome.heading: Let's get your library set up.
welcome.body: Romarr is a self-hosted ROM acquisition manager. This short wizard creates the admin account; the rest is configured from the Settings page once you're signed in.
welcome.tokenHint: The setup token was printed in the server logs the first time Romarr started. Look for a line beginning with "Setup token:".

admin.heading: Create the admin account
admin.body: This account holds the admin role and can configure every part of Romarr.
admin.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the X-Setup-Token from the boot logs

done.heading: All set
done.body: Romarr is ready. Configure the rest of the pipeline from Settings whenever you're ready — none of it is required to sign in.

errors.setupTokenInvalid: That setup token isn't valid. Check the server logs and paste it again.
errors.setupAlreadyDone: Romarr is already set up — sign in instead.
errors.validation: Some fields are invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.fallback: Setup failed. Check the server logs and try again.
